build_per_pixel_baseline_head: build a PerPixelBaselineHead for semantic segmentation using a pixel decoder and 1x1 conv predictor
build_per_pixel_baseline_plus_head: build a PerPixelBaselinePlusHead with a transformer predictor and optional deep supervision for semantic segmentation
run_forward_baseline_head: run the forward pass of PerPixelBaselineHead to get segmentation logits or training losses
run_forward_baseline_plus_head: run the forward pass of PerPixelBaselinePlusHead with deep supervision to compute auxiliary losses
compute_semantic_segmentation_losses: compute cross-entropy semantic segmentation losses with interpolated predictions and configurable ignore value
